claim.claim-text: 2. The solar cell according to claim 1, wherein a silicon oxide material layer is disposed between the metal oxide material of the oxygen-containing dielectric layer (111) having negative electricity.

3. The solar cell according to claim 1, wherein in a direction away from the front surface (100a), a distance (D3) from a position where an oxygen content reaches a maximum peak value in the passivation stack (110) to a position where the oxygen content reaches a secondary peak value in the passivation stack (110) is in a range of 40nm to 100nm, a distance (D2) from a position where a silicon content reaches a maximum peak value in the passivation stack (110) to the front surface (100a) is greater than 0nm and less than or equal to 30nm, and a distance (D1) from a position where a nitrogen content reaches a maximum peak value in the passivation stack (110) to the front surface (100a) is greater than or equal to 30nm.
4. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the metal oxide material includes at least one of aluminum oxide, gallium oxide, titanium oxide, or hafnium oxide.
5. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein an atomic fraction of oxygen in the oxygen-containing dielectric layer is in a range of 15% to 50%.

6. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the first passivation layer (112) includes at least two passivation sub-layers, and in a direction away from the front surface (100a), the passivation sub-layers gradually decrease in atomic fraction of silicon and gradually increase in atomic fraction of nitrogen.

7. The solar cell according to claim 6, wherein the first passivation layer (112) includes a bottom passivation sub-layer (132) closest to the front surface (100a) and a top passivation sub-layer (142) furthest from the front surface, wherein in the bottom passivation sub-layer (132), an atomic fraction of silicon is in a range of 60% to 70%, and an atomic fraction of nitrogen is in a range of 20% to 40%, and wherein in the top passivation sub-layer (142), an atomic fraction of silicon is in a range of 45% to 60%, and an atomic fraction of nitrogen is in a range of 30% to 50%.

8. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein in the second passivation layer (113), an atomic fraction of silicon is in a range of 30% to 60%, an atomic fraction of oxygen is in a range of 3% to 50%, and an atomic fraction of nitrogen is in a range of 5% to 50%.

9. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein a thickness of the oxygen-containing dielectric layer (111) is in a range of 1nm to 15nm in a direction perpendicular to the front surface (100a).

10. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein a thickness of the first passivation layer (112) is in a range of 30nm to 60nm in a direction perpendicular to the front surface (100a)

11. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein a thickness of the second passivation layer (113) is in a range of 20nm to 40nm in a direction perpendicular to the front surface (100a).

12. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the silicon nitride included in first passivation layer (112) is a first SimNn material, in which n/m is in a range of 0.5 to 1, where m represents the number of Si atoms and n represents the number of N atoms.

13. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the silicon oxynitride included in the second passivation layer (113) is a SiOiNj material, in which j/i is in a range of 0.1 to 0.6, where i represents the number of O atoms and j represents the number of N atoms.
